subject: Clean-sheet & Executive Package — May commit review (QBR prep)
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>; Cc: procurement@acmeanalytics.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clean-sheet & Executive Package — May commit review (QBR prep)

Team,

Kickoff for the May commit review — QBR cabinets need the clean-sheet and the executive package assembled. Goal is one consolidated leadership deck we can hand to execs at the May 20 QBR. Key asks:

- Update your pipeline rows in the attached commit_tracker_may.csv with the latest stage (including probability and expected close date).
- Add a one-line risk note for any >$50k deals (eg product risk, contract/legal, procurement hold).
- Flag any deals you expect to push past the quarter.

Deadlines: please complete your updates by EOD Wednesday, May 12 (PST). I will pull the top 10-12 commits and create the exec slides on Thursday.

Attachments: commit_tracker_may.csv (stub) — use column headers in the sheet. I also dropped a template for the exec slide in the Drive link below.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cQBRpack
HubSpot: HS-76431

If you think we need extra time for validation with legal/procurement for any partner deals, call it out in your row and ping Karthik.

Thanks — Aditya
Aditya Rao | Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clean-sheet & Executive Package — May commit review (QBR prep)

Aditya — thanks for the note. Quick Q on format: do you want the risk note to be a short bullet in the "notes" column or a separate line in the sheet? Also, can I include an ARR delta column (since several AEs track both ACV and ARR)?

I'll start with my team and push updates by EOD Wed. Planning to mark product dependencies explicitly.

—Laura
Laura Bennett | Sales Manager, Enterprise | Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 13:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clean-sheet & Executive Package — May commit review (QBR prep)

On Mon, May 10, 2027 at 11:18 AM Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com> wrote:
> Aditya — thanks for the note. Quick Q on format: do you want the risk note to be a short bullet in the "notes" column or a separate line in the sheet?

Laura — put the risk note in the notes column (single cell) and append an internal tag like [LEGAL], [PROC], [PRODUCT] as appropriate. Also agree with adding an ARR delta column — Marissa, if you can surface that in the deck it helps leadership see churn/expansion impact quickly.

I attached a working one-pager I use for exec calls (leadership_onepager.docx). Can we aim to have a first-pass exec pack by end-of-day Thursday May 13 so we have a day for review before the 17th leadership dry-run?

Jonas
Jonas Weber | Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachment: leadership_onepager.docx (stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Thanks — uploaded my team's rows and a starter slide deck.

Notes:
- I populated ARR and ARR delta for the top 8 deals; see the ARR column in the sheet.
- Added brief risk bullets for two deals (legal gating on data residency, procurement review delay).
- Attached a draft QBR_exec_slide_deck_v0.pptx with a top-10 list and suggested talking points.

Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: QBR_exec_slide_deck_v0.pptx, commit_tracker_may.csv (updated stub)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clean-sheet & Executive Package — May commit review (QBR prep)

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Short summary and next steps:

1) Aditya/Jonas — consolidate the top-10 and include ARR delta + risk tags by Thursday EOD (May 13).
2) Marissa/Laura — confirm procurement/legal status for the two flagged deals and add single-line remediation steps. Karthik to coordinate with legal; loop procurement contacts if timeline slips.
3) I'll run the leadership dry-run on Monday, May 17 at 9:00am PT — calendar invite to follow.

One ask for the deck: include an "ask" slide for any approval or credit requests we might bring to execs (discounts, SLA exceptions, credits). If you think a deal needs an exec decision, mark it with [EXEC-ASK] in the notes column.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni | VP, Revenue | Redwood Inference
